# dsh-cc-switch
cc-switch providers inside DeepSeek Harness.
把 cc-switch 里管理的 Claude Code / Codex 中转商配置一键同步成 DSH 模型路由。**不需要任何已配置的模型**——这正是它存在的理由：给一个还没有模型的 DSH 实例
里管理的 Claude Code / Codex 中转商配置一键同步成 DSH 模型路由。**不需要任何已配置的模型**——这正是它存在的理由：给一个还没有模型的 DSH 实例导入你已有的全部供应商。
Sync your cc-switch provider profiles into DSH model routes. **Works with zero models configured** —
that is the whole point: bootstrap a fresh DSH install from providers you already manage.

## Usage
Three planes, pick any:
| plane | how | needs a working model? | needs DSH running? |
| Terminal CLI | `npx dsh-cc-switch` (`--dry-run` to preview) | no | no — works before first boot |

| Startup | automatic (`syncOnStart`, default on) | no | — |
| Human command | type `/ccswitch` in t

he composer (`/ccswitch dry` to preview) | no | yes |
| Agent tool | ask the agent to run `ccswitch_

itch dry` to preview) | no | yes |
| Agent tool | ask the agent to run `ccswitch_sync` | yes | yes |
## How it works

- Opens the local cc-switch SQLite database **read-only**; cc-switch is never modified.
- Maps provi
ders onto `llm-pi-ai` routes through the DSH settings seam — changes take effect on the next request

, no restart.
- API keys are stored through the DSH credential seam as references (`CCS_*_KEY`); key
values never appear in settings, tool output, or model context.
| cc-switch | DSH route |
| `codex` provider (API-key relays) | `openai-responses` / `openai-completions` route, model from co

nfig TOML |
| `claude` provider (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` relays) | `anthropic-messages` route, models f

rom `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_NAME` |
| Official OAuth providers | skipped (pi-ai cannot OAuth) |
|
`gemini` / `claude-desktop` | skipped (roadmap) |
## Config
Override per row in your profile `cordis.patch.yml`:

| key | default | |

| `dbPath` | `~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db` | cc-switch database location |
| `prefix` | `ccs-` | route

id prefix |
| `apps` | `['codex', 'claude']` | app_types to sync |
| `syncOnStart` | `true` | run a
sync when the plugin loads |
## Limitations / roadmap
- Removed cc-switch providers are not auto-removed from DSH settings yet; delete stale `ccs-*` route

s in Settings → Models.
- A "import from cc-switch" button on the Models settings page (Web UI plugi
n tree), gemini mapping, DB change watching: planned.
